hero.label: Careers at Neryva
hero.title: Build intelligence that matters.
hero.description: We are looking for exceptional researchers, engineers, and operators who are driven to push the boundaries of physical AI. No bureaucracy. Just compute and autonomy.

items.title: Radical Autonomy
items.description: We hire exceptional people and get out of their way. No endless meetings or top-down roadmaps. If you have a hypothesis, you own the execution from design to deployment.

items.title: Massive Compute
items.description: Compute shouldn't be the bottleneck for fundamental breakthroughs. Every researcher and engineer has unrestricted access to our state-of-the-art multi-node H100 clusters.

items.title: Open Publication
items.description: We believe progress in foundation models should be shared. We actively encourage our teams to publish their non-critical findings and contribute back to the global research commons.

items.title: Physical Impact
items.description: We aren't building ad-optimizers or engagement loops. Your work directly impacts robotics, energy dispatch, and clinical care systems in the real world.
